description: Stage a blog post via structured meta+body (?format=post). Key e.g. blog/my-post.html. Membership: meta.collections; schedule: meta.visibleAt; SEO title: meta.seoTitle (the card shows meta.title); custom fields: meta.custom (typed per collection by get_collection_schema; fieldWarnings flags values that don't fit, never blocking).

seoTitle.description: SEO override for the <title>/og:title tags only. The blog card and listing always show `title`; empty or absent inherits `title`.

title.description: Post title — shown on the blog card/listing and used as the <title> unless seoTitle overrides it.

name: put_post
